verdict.rationale: Mercury documents a Webhooks API for real-time HTTP notifications when resources such as Transactions change. It offers create, update, verify, get, and delete operations on webhook endpoints, plus an Events endpoint for retrieving events. A changelog entry adds account-balance-change subscriptions. Missing for 10: full event-type catalog and delivery/retry/signature semantics in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery.
